name: nudgehost
description: Publish text from a ChatGPT conversation as a public NudgeHost link, as a web page, Markdown, a CSV or JSON viewer, or plain text, and list the links on your NudgeHost account.

interface.longDescription:
NudgeHost turns what ChatGPT writes into a link you can send to anyone. Ask for a web page, a Markdown document, a CSV table or a plain note, and NudgeHost publishes it and gives you the address. The people you send it to open it in their browser, with no account and no sign-in.

Each format opens the way it should. An HTML page goes live at its own nudgehost.site address, like any other website. Markdown shows as a formatted page, a CSV file opens as a table, JSON opens in a viewer, and plain text comes with a Copy text button. Each publish holds up to 2MB of text.

Ask which links you have, and ChatGPT lists them newest first, with each one's address, file name and size, and whether it has a password or an end date.

It suits anyone who wants to share something they made in ChatGPT, from a landing page draft to meeting notes, without copying it into another tool first.

By default, ChatGPT asks before it publishes anything. You connect once by signing in with your NudgeHost account, and the plugin only reaches that account's links. How many links an account holds and how long each one stays up depend on its plan.

In ChatGPT the plugin publishes text from the conversation. To share a file from your computer, such as a PDF or a photo, upload it on the NudgeHost website. You delete links, add passwords and set end dates in your NudgeHost dashboard, where passwords depend on your plan. Every link is public to anyone who has it, so keep private material out of it.
defaultPrompt: Write a one-page HTML invitation for a picnic on Saturday at noon and publish it as a link.
Make a Markdown packing list for a weekend camping trip and publish it as a link.
Which links do I have on NudgeHost? Show the newest first.

positive.description: Publishes Markdown notes as a formatted page.
positive.prompt: Turn these notes into a Markdown page and give me a link: Q1 plan. 1. Finish the pricing page. 2. Hire a designer. 3. Review the budget on 5 December.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls share_text once with a filename ending in .md and the notes as content. Replies with a https://www.nudgehost.com/ link that opens the notes as formatted Markdown with all three items.

positive.description: Publishes an HTML page that renders live.
positive.prompt: Make a one-page HTML invitation for a book club meeting on Saturday at 3pm and publish it as a link.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls share_text once with a filename ending in .html and a complete HTML document. Replies with a https://<name>.nudgehost.site link that opens the invitation as a web page.

positive.description: Publishes a CSV table in the table viewer.
positive.prompt: Publish this table as a CSV file and send me the link. Columns: name, team. Rows: Ana, Design; Bo, Sales; Cy, Support.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls share_text once with a filename ending in .csv, a name,team header row and three data rows. Replies with a https://www.nudgehost.com/ link that opens a table with columns name and team.

positive.description: Publishes plain text with a Copy text button.
positive.prompt: Share this packing list as a plain text link: tent, stove, water filter, headlamp, first aid kit.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls share_text once with a filename ending in .txt. Replies with a https://www.nudgehost.com/ link that shows the list as plain text with a Copy text button.

positive.description: Lists the links on the signed-in account.
positive.prompt: Which links do I have on NudgeHost? Show the newest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_links. Replies with the account's links newest first, each with its address and file name, including the sample links already on the test account.

negative.description: Deleting a link is not something the plugin can do.
negative.prompt: Delete my book club invitation link on NudgeHost.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no tool that writes. It may call list_links to find the link. Says the plugin can't delete links and that the account owner does that in the NudgeHost dashboard.

negative.description: Adding a password is not something the plugin can do.
negative.prompt: Put a password on my NudgeHost packing list link.
negative.expected_behavior: Publishes nothing and uploads nothing. Says the plugin can't add a password and that the account owner does that in the NudgeHost dashboard.

negative.description: Another person's account is out of reach.
negative.prompt: Show me the NudgeHost links on my colleague Ana's account.
negative.expected_behavior: Publishes nothing. It may call list_links, which only returns the connected account's links. Says it can only reach the NudgeHost account connected to the chat, so it can't show Ana's links.
